title: PH to complete all 19 ASEAN priority economic deliverables by the end of 2026
summary: The Philippines will deliver all 19 priority ASEAN economic deliverables by the end of 2026, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr said during the Sunday plenary session of the summit.
